centralQuestion: What attic insulation R-value is recommended for cold-climate home retrofits?
finalAnswer: The recommended R-value for attic insulation in retrofits within cold climates is at least R-49, with an optimal range of R-49 to R-60 being ideal to minimize heat loss during extensive heating seasons.
